text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was completely captivated by the 
winning Umamusume. ...I was nothing more 
than a background extra.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"As if I have... the talent to be a 
protagonist—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, damn it all! This sucks! I'm so 
pathetic for being this clumsy!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch...! Next time for sure, I'm 
gonna create an awesome masterpiece~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Trainer! Next time for 
sure, I'll move everyone's hearts with my 
running!
